lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I realize this is a rather abrupt question,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: but do you believe in ghosts?
I've seen a ghost in the hospital on several occasions.
Pepper! Behind you!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Don't do that!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: That's not funny.
Hehe, sorry. Anyway, why are you asking?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Unfortunately,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: death is something inexorably linked with hospitals,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: and so it's only natural that they're a hotbed for ghost stories.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: As an adult, you can just laugh it off,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: but kids have a tendency to actually believe in that kind of thing.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: They might have trouble sleeping,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: or be scared of going to the restroom at night.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: A lot of scary ghost stories have been circulating recently, and it's got me worried.
What kind of stories?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: The worst is about a girl who carries around a needle.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: You can often hear her voice in the dead of night,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: and if you follow that voice, you're led to a locked research lab

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: that hasn't been used in ages,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: yet somehow has light seeping out from under the door.
Wait a minute...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Even though everyone knows not to go in that room,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: in they go, as if they've been possessed by an external force.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Inside,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: there's a girl with braided hair

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: standing with her back turned,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: who slowly turns her head and says:

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Oh, another child who's been naughty?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Then she slowly starts to approach you,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: while staring directly into your soul the entire time.
Pepper...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I know, it's terrifying.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: That must be what's got the children so spooked.
No, it's not that.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: What do you mean?
I think you're talking about Mary.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I'll check back in with you once I've talked to Mary.
